expiry_calendar_policy: rule-derived second Thursday, advanced to previous reviewed KRX session on closure; not independently reconciled to historical contract master
target_policy: nonflat, strict exact KRX and US sessions; no filling; same dates per target and asset
probability_policy: true observed class frequencies; 0.5 is neutral

call_rule.interpretation: Retrospective selected median rule. Its binary direction is not a calibrated probability.
